lines.text: The beetle's down. The museum goes quiet, except for a steady tick from the curator's office.
Splendid work. Truly. You may go.
I am not ticking. You are ticking.
He's clockwork. He's been winding up the exhibits. Oh, this is going on the invoice.
Every collection needs a curator. And every curator needs a centerpiece. Do excuse me.
He turns a brass key in the wall and slips out the back. In the main hall, a great many bones stand up.
Everything is on the invoice. Run.
